name: Masato Tanaka & Tatsuhito Takaiwa
notes: An unnamed pairing of two K-PRO Sekigun wrestlers, billed as K-PRO's own KP World Tag Team Champions ahead of a defense against Team FTW's Togi Makabe and Toru Yano on 19 July 2009.
caption: An unnamed K-PRO pairing billed as the promotion's own reigning Tag Team Champions on its Desperado tour.

name: No Remorse Corps
notes: A visiting American trio who won the KP World Trios Championship from Team FTW's Tomohiro Ishii, Jado and Gedo and retained it for a second time on 6 July 2009.
caption: A visiting American trio who held K-PRO's own Trios Championship through its Desperado tour, retaining twice against Team FTW.
